head: codex/679-s3-deployable-observatory
title: [v0.92.1][Observatory] Add deployable static edge plan
body:
Closes #679

Adds the standalone, deployment-ready Terraform and operator contract for serving the #512 Observatory from a private versioned S3 origin through CloudFront at observatory.csm.agent-logic.ai. Includes ACM and Route53, CSP/security headers, access logging, safe caching, rollback guidance, and an inert profile-gated redacted readback script.

No AWS plan, apply, readback, or live Runtime mutation was performed; live execution remains deferred pending explicit operator authorization.
